messages.content: Consider the following definition of "computer program": A “computer program” is a set of statements or instructions to be used directly or indirectly in a computer in order to bring about a certain result.   Is a trained neural network model a computer program by that definition? Ensure that the ratio of sentence types (declarative, interrogative, exclamatory) in your response is balanced.

message.content:
A trained neural network model can be a computer program under that definition.
Its weights and architecture encode instructions for transforming inputs into outputs.
It is used directly or indirectly to bring about a certain result.
Is its structure a set of instructions?
Do its weights guide the computation?
Can a computer run it to produce results?
What a broad definition it is!
How complex the behavior can be!
How easily it can be used!
